punchline: In The Alchemist, a young stranger saves a desert oasis because he watched two hawks fight and was willing to bet his life on what it meant.
thirty_sec: In The Alchemist, Santiago reaches a desert oasis. Tribes are at war, but by tradition nobody attacks an oasis. Then he watches two hawks fight and sees a vision of an army riding in. He's a stranger, but he warns the chieftains. They arm the oasis and tell him that if the weapons aren't used by sundown, one will be used on him. The next day the horsemen come, and they're defeated.
question: Have you ever trusted a small sign that turned out to be right?
